scope: All spatial positions from the already sealed capture for sample0. This is a first FC2 opportunity screen, not a cross-sample performance campaign. Prior FC1 signature results are not reused as FC2 measurements.
arithmetic: z_tc=theta_c*g_tc; phi_c=theta_c*W_c. Fixed thresholds retain their continuous-value amplitude. Integer-numerator diagnostics use non-1 theta; no frozen FP32 or new AEE claim.
strong_baseline: All variants read each non-silent source coefficient vector once per output slice; direct FTP broadcasts across complete T. No T-fold source-read saving against this baseline. LoAS uses one pseudo sum of non-silent sources and zero-bit corrections; allow known-empty outputs to bypass and count all other corrections.
RSRpp: Use section4.3 prose semantics: for each level t, emit odd-index bucket sums to Y_t, then pair indices 2p/2p+1. Absent structural buckets bypass; first assignment is not an addition. Cancellation to numeric zero does not permit occupancy-based skipping. The pruned comparator discards index0 parent because it has no future high-bit consumer.
streaming_candidate: Classify complete T into narrow membership lists; seal all C sources for a spatial position. Walk the nonempty signature trie in increasing-signature postorder. Construct each leaf from member coefficients, emit its Y0 use, and combine sibling values while returning upward. Emit odd-index node values into the corresponding Y_t. Never allocate an R-entry wide bucket array; retain T output states plus a measured working stack bounded by T. This inherits RSR++ algebra and ordinary depth-first scheduling; novelty is not presumed.
narrow_layout: Reference directly indexed head[1024] plus next[source_id] with null encoded in ceil(log2(C+1)) bits and an independent 1024-bit valid bitmap. At a new position explicitly clear bitmap; uninitialized head entries are not read. Prepend members to avoid tail table: head read only on nonfirst class member, one head write and one next write for every non-silent source. After seal one head read per class and one next read per member for every output slice. Fixed ascending class enumeration scans up to1024 valid bits; no free CAM/sort claim.
classifier_cost_scope: Count source signature inspections, valid-bit clear/test/update and member-table accesses. Source arrival order permitting producer-side overlap is not yet established; do not credit hidden preprocessing latency. Head/next accesses are narrow operations, not same-width cycles or bytes of external traffic.
bank_proxy: Use c modulo8 source bank consistent with current group16/half8 source mapping. Report sum over classes of max bank-member count versus max bank-member count over all live sources. These are ideal request-round lower bounds assuming independent one-request-per-bank issue; exclude reduction, responses, buffering and output service, so are not RTL cycles.
value_diagnostics: 64 evenly spaced spatial positions per stage, eight output lanes; weights deterministic INT8 with extreme lanes and theta_c=(999883+17c)/1000000. Compare full T outputs for direct, LoAS, flat groups, materialized RSRpp and streaming RSRpp. All output positions, including zero, must be committed.
